description: Boundary coverage for a computed delay function: when the function yields a per-call sequence of values it must be consulted afresh with the incremented attempt index on each successive retry; a computed value of zero must still schedule a prompt retry; and when the retryable outcome is a received response rather than a network error the function must be invoked with that response's status and no error, confirming both argument shapes are supplied across scenarios.

cases.expected_output:
retryDelay_call attempt=0 error=first error status=none
retryDelay_call attempt=1 error=second error status=none
fetch_count=3
url=http://someUrl
options_passed=true
outcome=resolved status=200

retryDelay_call attempt=0 error=first error status=none
fetch_count=2
url=http://someUrl
options_passed=true
outcome=resolved status=200

retryDelay_call attempt=0 error=none status=503
fetch_count=2
url=http://someUrl
options_passed=true
outcome=resolved status=200
